christmas.text: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!

easter.text: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said!

pentecost.text: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.

passover.text: And this day will be a memorial for you, and you are to celebrate it as a feast to the LORD,

communion.text: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.

healing.text: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,

miracles.text: You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.

sea-of-galilee.text: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.

advent.text: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.

palm-sunday.text: Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!

good-friday.text: But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.

lent.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

ascension.text: After He had said this, they watched as He was taken up, and a cloud hid Him from their sight.

epiphany.text: Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.

harvest.text: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.

new-year.text: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail. They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!

reformation.text: The righteous will live by faith.

mothers-day.text: Her children rise up and call her blessed

fathers-day.text: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.

trinity.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.

bible-sunday.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

childrens-day.text: Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
